description:
Field trial trait data held in CropSNPdb for this crop (lentil diversity panel field traits (days to flowering, maturity and others; USASK)). With no arguments, lists the
available traits. Filter by line and/or trait: trait matches the
exact name or any part of it (e.g. 'Height', 'grain yield'). Most phenotyped lines are in the
Lens culinaris CDC Redberry v2 dataset.
name: snp_phenotypes
